note: data-modifying CTE with RETURNING * and qualified outer select

sql: WITH RECURSIVE r(n) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT n+1 FROM r WHERE n < 5) SELECT n FROM r WHERE n > 10
note: recursive CTE outer WHERE filters all rows, returns empty
